title: 第23章 到处都是BOSS第24章 规律
content_zh:
;;
已经没有逃跑的空间了。
只能拼了！
求生的本能压倒了恐惧。
丹田内那点珍贵的气被瞬间点燃，被他毫不吝啬的尽数迸发出来。
“天罡耀灵，北斗垂光！魒星指路，魑魅伏藏！焚符破秽，炁摄不祥！丹朱口神，卫我真常！”
咒语此刻带着一丝破音的嘶喊，在死寂的教室中炸响。
他双手结印的速度快到了极致，指尖划过道道残影。
这一次，他没有选择将力量凝成一线。
面对这四面八方涌来的鬼潮，范围才是关键。
嗡！
一圈肉眼可见的清冷光晕，以他结印的双手为中心，猛地向四面八方扩散开去。
光晕所过之处，空气发出“滋滋”的轻响，仿佛冰雪消融。
冲在最前面的几只鬼手触碰到光晕的瞬间，如同碰到了烧红的烙铁。
嗤嗤嗤！
数道焦黑的烟丝瞬间从鬼手上腾起。
那几只鬼手猛地痉挛蜷缩，发出几声压抑短促，如同指甲刮过玻璃般的凄厉呜咽，被光晕触碰下，动作骤然一僵。
后面涌上的鬼物也被这圈蕴含着破邪之力的光晕阻挡，冲锋的势头为之一挫，潮水般的攻势出现了短暂的凝滞。
就是现在！
张唯甚至来不及看这定身效果能维持多久，也顾不上丹田内瞬间被抽走近半气的虚弱感。

他猛地中断了与内景世界的连接。
意识如同被巨力拉扯，眼前的鬼影、教室、光晕瞬间扭曲、破碎、消散……
“呼！呼！呼！”
现实世界的教室里，张唯猛地睁眼，身体因为瞬间的脱力向后重重撞在椅背上，发出哐当一声巨响。
他大口大口地喘着粗气，冷汗如同瀑布般从额头滚落，瞬间浸透了单薄的t恤。
心脏在胸腔里疯狂擂鼓，几乎要破膛而出。
眼前似乎还残留着那无数张模糊面孔和抓来的鬼手，耳边仿佛还回响着那令人牙酸的“咔哒”声。
“我草，我草！太他妈吓人了……”
他捂着剧烈起伏的胸口，声音带着劫后余生的颤抖和难以置信的后怕。
几十只鬼物如同丧尸般蜂拥扑来的场面，那纯粹的恶意和冰冷的数量碾压，比单独面对林晓或者瘦长鬼影带来的压迫感还要恐怖十倍。
简直是一场噩梦。
要是经常这样他都觉得自己铁定会得心脏病。
张唯扶着课桌，双腿发软地站起来，几乎是踉跄着冲出了空无一人的教室。
夜晚校园的凉风吹在汗湿的背上，带来一阵寒意，却让他感觉稍微活过来一点。
在冷风中怔立许久，看着周围路过的青春少女，张唯终于平静下来。
不行，还得再验证一次，这次得找个相对安全点的地方验证最后一个想法。
他抬头看向远处的一座建筑。
图书馆。
大学图书馆，知识汇聚之地，总该有点不一样吧？
他缓缓走向灯火通明的图书馆大楼。

顺利混进去后，张唯漫步在书架间，深夜的图书馆自习区依旧零星坐着些苦读的学生。
张唯随后找了个最角落，背靠墙壁，周围几米内都没人的位置坐下。
这里安静，灯光柔和，还弥漫着书本特有的油墨香气，多少驱散了些他心头的寒意。
content_en:
;;
There was no room for escape.
All we can do is fight!
The instinct to survive overcame fear.
The precious energy in his dantian was instantly ignited, and he unleashed it without hesitation.
"Tiangang shines brightly, Beidou shines down! The zodiac stars point the way, and evil spirits hide in treasures! Burning talismans destroys filth, and Qi captures ominous things! Danzhu Moushen, guard me forever!"
The spell now screamed with a hint of broken sound, exploding in the dead silence of the classroom.
The speed with which he formed seals with his hands was extremely fast, and his fingertips traced the afterimages.
This time, he did not choose to condense his strength into a thread.
Facing this wave of ghosts coming from all directions, range is the key.
Buzz!
A circle of cold light visible to the naked eye, centered on his sealed hands, suddenly spread in all directions.
Wherever the halo passed, the air made a soft "sizzling" sound, as if the ice and snow were melting.
The moment the ghost hands at the front touched the halo, it was like touching a red-hot iron.
Tsk tsk tsk!
Several strands of burnt tobacco instantly rose from the ghost's hand.
Those ghost hands suddenly convulsed and curled up, and let out a few short, suppressed sounds, like nails scraping against glass, and their movements suddenly froze when they were touched by the halo.
The ghosts that surged up from behind were also blocked by the halo containing evil-destroying power. The momentum of the charge was dampened, and the tide-like offensive briefly stagnated.
That's it now!
Zhang Wei didn't even have time to see how long the immobilizing effect would last, and he couldn't care less about the feeling of weakness when nearly half of his energy was taken out of his dantian in an instant.
He suddenly broke off the connection with the interior world.
His consciousness seemed to be pulled by a huge force, and the ghosts, classrooms, and halos in front of him instantly distorted, shattered, and dissipated...
"Hoo! Hoo! Hoo!"
In the classroom in the real world, Zhang Wei opened his eyes suddenly, and his body hit the back of the chair hard due to the momentary loss of strength, making a loud clang.
He was breathing heavily, and cold sweat rolled down his forehead like a waterfall, instantly soaking his thin T-shirt.
His heart was beating wildly in his chest, almost bursting out of his chest.
There seemed to still be countless blurred faces and grasping ghost hands in front of me, and the heart-wrenching "click" sound seemed to be echoing in my ears.
"Holy shit, shit! It's so damn scary..."
He held his chest that was rising and falling violently, and his voice was filled with trembling and unbelievable fear for the rest of his life.
The scene of dozens of ghosts swarming like zombies, the sheer malice and cold crushing numbers, was ten times more terrifying than the oppression caused by facing Lin Xiao alone or the lanky ghost.
What a nightmare.
If he did this often, he felt that he would definitely have a heart attack.
Zhang Wei held on to the desk, stood up with weak legs, and almost staggered out of the empty classroom.
The cool breeze of the campus at night blew on his sweaty back, bringing a chill, but it made him feel a little more alive.
After standing stunned in the cold wind for a long time and looking at the young girls passing by, Zhang Wei finally calmed down.
No, I have to verify it again. This time I have to find a relatively safe place to verify the last idea.
He looked up at a building in the distance.
library.
University libraries, the place where knowledge gathers, should be a little different, right?
He walked slowly toward the brightly lit library building.
After successfully sneaking in, Zhang Wei strolled among the bookshelves. There were still scattered students studying hard in the study area of ​​the library late at night.
Zhang Wei then found a corner and sat down with his back against the wall and no one within a few meters around him.
It was quiet here, the lights were soft, and there was also the unique aroma of ink from books, which somewhat dispelled the chill in his heart.
